_comment: Declare which folders hold PRODUCTION source. Members under these paths (or whose library folder name matches) are marked authoritative; when the same member name exists elsewhere with different content, queries prefer the authoritative copy and say so. Paths are matched case-insensitively as prefixes or as a folder name.
_system_includes_comment: Copybook names your compiles read from a product library you do not fetch, beside the ones IBM supplies that the build knows already - exactly these: CICS DFHAID, DFHBMSCA, DFHEIBLK, DFHEIVAR, DFHMSRCA; MQ CMQV, CMQXV, CMQODV, CMQODL, CMQMDV, CMQMDL, CMQGMOV, CMQGMOL, CMQPMOV, CMQPMOL. Any other MQ copy file your programs copy (a trigger program's, a dead-letter or bridge header's), or another product's, goes here. A COPY of one that no member of the index carries is 'supplied by a product library, not in the estate': never NOT FOUND, never a partial program. A copy you do keep in a COPYLIB is expanded like any copybook. In sources.json the same key reaches the manifest the UI writes.
_external_interfaces_comment: What crosses the mainframe boundary and with whom - no source file states the peer. kind: ndm|ftp|mq|ddf|webservice|zosconnect|file|other; direction: in|out|both; one of dataset|queue|table|transaction|program|path. Shown by `interfaces` and on `dataset X`.
